items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Owney Madden and them people that used to run whiskey.

ctx.x: It came in a can. And it came in quart cans, too. Like an olive can, like an oblong, square, tall... Just like you'd pack whiskey, but with a can. Now, the reason for that was they used to make this Chicken Cock Whiskey in Canada, and when the rum-runners would chase the guys... Owney Madden and them people that used to run whiskey. They talk about it now, if you mention his name...
